notes.title: MAJOR Demo Update - (Version 2)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Dracula (version 2) Updates:[/b][/h1]

+Playtime is now 1-2 hours
+Alex's cat can now learn more abilities and has their own shops.
+You can absorb your first soul and expand your powers
+Added Epic Items - Every monster drops a unique item (1% drop rate).
+Updated the graphic quality
+Updated all shops and shop menus
+Storyline can now progress until a little after Mystic Mountain.




[h3][b]New Areas:[/b][/h3]
+Ancient Forest (West)
+Citta di Mare
+Hermit's Hut
+Mystic Mountain
+Tent
+??? (secret unlockable area)
+??? (secret unlockable area 2)




[h3][b]Items:[/b][/h3]
+The first gold medal now works in the demo and will unlock healing at save points - don't miss it!
+Changed Red Apples to Power Apples
+Added Black Apples that increase all stats (super rare)
+Most shops have a "10%" chance to offer rare items



[h3][b]Feedback:[/b][/h3]
[i]Thanks for all of your feedback!  We've been listening and fixed any bugs you told us about.
We'd love to hear more of what you think, so drop us a line.[/i]

Changes we made from your feedback:
+Antidote herbs are available in shops and for harvesting in the fields
+Sokoban Puzzles are more user-friendly
